name: Black Gem Foundry
summary: Black Gem Foundry is a mining facility and group dungeon in Coldharbour accessed from southern Solstice. It is included in the Feast of Shadows DLC alongside Naj-Caldeesh. The entrance is located northwest of the Shell-Tide Village Wayshrine. A number of passive creatures such as daedrats, scuttlers, snakes, and white torchbugs are found in numbers within. Daedric Titans and gristlewings may also be seen flying around.
